prompt:
Our team has been building a precision agriculture SaaS platform called AgroSync. Over the past few months, we've gathered market research notes, customer interview transcripts, survey results, and internal brainstorming documents — they're all sitting in the workspace in a somewhat disorganized state.

We need a comprehensive strategic analysis to help us decide which customer segment to pursue first, set realistic revenue targets for our seed round, and better understand how our customers actually make buying decisions.

Please review all the available materials and produce a structured, investor-ready report saved as `market_insights_report.json`. The report should cover everything needed to understand our market opportunity and our target customer — from who they are, to how big the opportunity is, to how they decide to buy.
